summary: Supplement Plan Redesign Frontend Testing Complete - All 15 key features PASS. The new teal gradient header with personalized greeting, sun icon, and action icons renders correctly. Erinnerung reminder card with smart time-slot fallback shows correctly with supplement items and action buttons. Tagesplan tab is default with time-based cards (Morgens/Abends) showing colorful pill icons. All tabs (Stack, Tagesplan, Wochen, Analyse) work correctly.

minor.note: 404 error logged when loading Analyse tab - likely interaction analysis API endpoint

critical_code_review_comments: supplement-plan.tsx: Well-structured redesign with proper LinearGradient, PillIcon component, and IIFE pattern for activeSlot computation
Pill icons use correct PILL_STYLES mapping with color-coded backgrounds (FBE9E7 for red, FFF8E1 for yellow, E8F5E9 for green, etc.)
Smart fallback logic in getActiveTimeSlot() correctly prioritizes current time slot, then falls back to morning if noon is empty
All new styles (ns StyleSheet) are clean and well-organized with proper shadow styling
Minor console warning: expo-av deprecated (will be removed in SDK 54) - not blocking but should plan migration to expo-audio
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test profile with 8 supplements (5 morning, 0 noon, 3 evening)
